NP Presspad 1.1.8 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — build and release tooling improvements only, no user-facing changes.

Releases are now tagged and published automatically once a version bump lands on the main branch, with built-in checks that the build is notarized and every update file is present before anything goes live. This also fixes an issue where a release could go out with an incomplete set of update files (which briefly made the in-app update check fail with an error after 1.1.6).

## Dependency updates

- electron-builder 26.15.3 → 26.8.1 (deliberate downgrade: 26.15.3 split release assets across duplicate drafts; pinned until fixed upstream)
